relationships.subject: AM404
relationships.evidence_quote: AM404 attenuated mechanical and cold hyperalgesia with minimal effects on motor coordination.

relationships.subject: AM251
relationships.evidence_quote: AM251 significantly inhibited the antihyperalgesic action of AM404, whereas capsazepine showed a potentiating effect.

relationships.subject: AM404
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that AM404 exerts antihyperalgesic effects primarily via CB<sub>1</sub>, but not CB<sub>2</sub>, receptor activation at the site of the spinal cord.

key_findings: Intrathecal AM404 reduced CCI-induced mechanical and cold hyperalgesia primarily via spinal CB1, not CB2.
TRPV1 antagonism potentiated AM404 effect, suggesting a pronociceptive TRPV1 role.
